title: Lace Cap Sleeve Mermaid Wedding Guest Dress
descriptionHtml:
This midi dress combines a flattering surplice bodice with delicate lace cap sleeves for a refined, feminine look. The V-neckline frames the upper body beautifully, while the softly draped waist enhances shape without feeling restrictive. Finished with a fluid ruffle hem, it moves effortlessly with every step. A reliable choice for wedding guest dressing, cocktail parties, semi formal evenings, and mother of the bride occasions.


Tips: Prioritize selecting based on the bust measurement; the entire garment is stretchy, and the waist and hip areas can stretch by at least 2 inches.

 

Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Midi.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises lace.


Stretch: Fabric is high stretch.
